title: Proof-of-Work Task Spec
description: Defines the expected input->output behavior of a single digital-electronics task, used by Phase 3 to verify a student's submission video.

verification_mode.description: state_match: order doesn't matter, each listed input state must appear at some point with the correct output. sequence_match: steps must occur in the given order (e.g. counters, step logic driven by the push button).

unlisted_input_policy.description: What to do if the video shows an input combination NOT in expected_behavior. ignore = don't penalize; must_be_absent = fail if it ever appears; must_match_default = compare its output against `default_output` if provided.

default_output.description: Only used when unlisted_input_policy = must_match_default. Same shape as one entry's `output` field.

timing.description: Global tolerances for reading state off the video.

min_hold_time_ms.description: Minimum time an input/output state must be stable before it counts as an observed state (filters flicker/bounce/hand-in-frame noise).

max_gap_ms.description: For sequence_match only: max allowed time between consecutive steps before the sequence is considered broken. null = no limit.

all_or_nothing.description: If true, every entry in expected_behavior must be satisfied to pass. If false, use pass_threshold.

pass_threshold.description: Required only if all_or_nothing is false. Fraction of expected_behavior entries that must be satisfied.

metadata.description: Free-form: unit/topic name, points, course reference, etc. Not used by the verification logic itself.

id.description: Local name used to reference this component in expected_behavior, e.g. 'sw1'.

bit_order.description: Only for dip_switch_4pos. Maps physical switch position (left to right, 1-4) to bit weight. Default [8,4,2,1] (switch 1 = MSB).

input_state.description: Keys are input component ids. dip_switch_4pos value = 4-char binary string e.g. '1010'. push_button value = 'pressed' or 'released', or use event form below for sequence steps.

output_state.description: Keys are output component ids. led value = 'on'/'off'. seven_segment_display value = single char '0'-'9', 'A'-'F', 'off', or 'invalid'.

trigger.description: What must happen to advance to this step. Either an input_state to reach, or a discrete event.

event.description: Use for momentary-button-driven steps (e.g. counter increments on each press) instead of a held input_state.

component_id.description: Required if event is used - which input component the event applies to.
